content.title: 3 Things: Defense stocks, China trade, Tether
content.description: European defense stocks rose (SAAB-B.ST, BA.L, RHM.DE, HO.PA) after President Trumps shift in policy towards Ukraine. In a move that could appease U.S trade negotiators, China says it will forego asking for benefits it gains from its status as a developing country from the WTO. Tether, the issuer of the world's largest stablecoin is in talks with investors to raise $20 billion. This deal would give the company a valuation of $500 billion - making it one of the world's most valuable private firms. For more live coverage of markets watch the full episode of Market Sunrise and head to Yahoo Finance.
